description: Phase 7A Part E audit fixture: a representative reconstruction of the reported 'superteam that only got 70-12' bug -- exact seasons chosen for the named legends where the user did not specify one (Magic 1983-84, Moses Malone 1983-84, Garnett 2008-09, Booker 2021-22 were exact; LeBron/Kobe/KD/KAT seasons were reconstructed to match the spirit of the report, including 'Kevin Durant at PF').
